description: Phase D + Phase 6 — fade-out envelope is now the post-end held tail. Clip starts at frame 0, duration 60 (clipEnd=60). Section break at frame 60 (microseconds 60/30*1_000_000=2_000_000) with fadeSeconds=0.5 (15 frames at 30fps). New fade-out window is [clipEnd, clipEnd+15) = [60, 75). At frame 45 well inside the clip, no envelope -> 1.0. At frame 60 (held last frame at start of tail), multiplier = 1 - 0/15 = 1.0. At frame 65 (mid fade-out), multiplier = 1 - 5/15 = 10/15 ~= 0.667. At frame 74 (last frame in window), multiplier = 1 - 14/15 = 1/15 ~= 0.067. SeekToFrame avoids the section auto-pause path entirely.
